page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual server instance delivered via a KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. Cache provisions include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512 VNNI), and cryptographic accelerators like AES and SHA-NI. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of memory, equating to 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, with no bundled local storage, no included public IPv4 addresses, and zero GPUs. Network throughput is bounded at a 2 Gbps baseline.

Benchmark measurements indicate consistent single-threaded execution balanced against limited aggregate compute throughput. In single-core testing, the instance registers average tier results, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1580.0, a stress-ng single-core score of 1873.79, single-threaded gzip compression of 28.12 GB/sec, and bzip3 decompression of 10.8 GB/sec. Conversely, overall multithreaded capacity ranks in the bottom 10%, reflecting its 2-vCPU configuration with a Geekbench multi-core score of 1823.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 2992.58. Large-block uncached memory operations register 13.97 GB/sec for reads and 12.92 GB/sec for writes, contributing to a lower-tier PassMark memory score of 1237.07.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio provides favorable resource density for tasks demanding high memory capacity relative to low compute footprints. Because local storage is absent, all persistent storage depends on network-attached options, which share overall I/O context with the 2 Gbps network baseline. While Redis SET operations hit 2.0 million operations per second, static web serving remains at 3.38 GB/sec and lightweight LLM inference runs at 59.68 tokens per second on small models. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is suited for moderately sized caching layers, small in-memory key-value databases, lightweight background workers, and memory-bound enterprise staging environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.large is a memory-optimized KVM instance featuring an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz with 2 dedicated vCPUs (1 physical core) and 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. CPU extensions include AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators, while GPUs and local storage are omitted entirely, relying on external network-attached volumes alongside a 2 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark profiles exhibit average single-core capacity (1580.0 Geekbench single-core, 28.12 GB/sec gzip compression) countered by lower multithreaded metrics (1823.0 Geekbench multi-core) due to the low core count. The server provides a cost-efficient hardware profile for memory-heavy setups with minimal concurrent compute requirements, making it suitable for in-memory caching nodes, small Redis deployments, and memory-intensive background utilities.
